# Inline Text Formatting

This sentence has **bold text**, *italic text*, and ***bold italic*** together.

It also has ~~strikethrough~~ (GFM) and a plain [autolinked URL](https://vitepress.dev/) plus a bare autolink https://mintlify.com/docs to exercise GFM autolinking.

Mixed run: **bold with `inline code` inside** and *italic with a [link](./internal-links.md) inside*.
